thread:
Zoe R.: Hey team, excited to start! My desk kit arrived but the power brick is missing (dock only has a short USB-C pigtail), and the monitor didn't include the VESA plate. Also when I try to join CompanyCorp-Enterprise Wi-Fi my Mac prompts for a 'machine certificate' — I don't see it in Self-Service. Filed ticket IT-5199. Any quick tips while IT triages?

Caleb (IT): welcome Zoe! Sorry about that. Quick checks: 1) can you confirm the dock model printed on the underside? 2) screenshot the Wi‑Fi cert error? 3) for the VESA plate, is the monitor the single- or dual-arm kit?

Zoe R.: Dock label: "Marlin Pro Dock" S/N MRL-331. Screenshot: "802.1X authentication failed: machine certificate not found" (I clicked Self-Service -> Devices -> Enroll but it times out). Monitor is single-arm.

Caleb (IT): Thanks. Two parallel actions: A) I'll trigger a device enrollment token and attach it to the ticket so you can do one-click enrollment (should bypass the timeout). B) I'll ship a replacement 120W power brick + VESA plate and a short USB-C charge/data cable. Which address should I use (same as onboarding shipping)?

Zoe R.: Shipping to 123 Harbor St, Apt 4B, Boston, MA (same as onboarding). Appreciate it.

Caleb (IT): Got it. Kit outbound: 1x 120W USB-C power brick (US), 1x USB-C 100W certified cable (30cm), 1x VESA 75/100 plate + screws. Tracking: https://ship.example/track/1Z555PK55555555555 ETA 2 business days. I also attached an enrollment token to IT-5199 — try clicking the link in the ticket or open Self-Service -> Devices -> Enroll and use the token code.

it-bot: Ticket IT-5199 updated by Caleb (IT): "Outbound kit and enrollment token attached."

Priya S.: welcome Zoe :wave: For the VESA plate install the short guide in #new-hire-ops pinned messages — it's just 4 screws. Also if enrollment still times out DM Caleb and we can do a quick zoom to complete the MDM step.

Zoe R.: Thanks all. Quick test: I tried the enrollment link and it accepted the token this time — installing now. Will report back after the kit arrives and monitor mount is attached.

Caleb (IT): Great — once the device enrolls the machine cert will be pushed automatically and Wi-Fi should connect with your redwood credentials (username zoe@redwood.com). If for any reason the cert doesn't appear, run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and then reboot.

Zoe R.: Enrollment finished, cert installed, Wi-Fi connected :tada: Thanks for the fast help. Still waiting on the physical kit for the VESA and power brick, but I can use a spare laptop charger for now.

Caleb (IT): Awesome — marking ticket IT-5199 as pending delivery. Reopen if the kit doesn't fix the mount/power within 48h.

Zoe R.: Will do, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
